write_up: Your resume shows an Ohio LMSW working with families involved with child protective services, after intake work at Lakeview Community Center. It's common to describe casework as a list of duties, but here a recruiter has to guess how many families you carry and what your assessments and plans inform. That makes it harder to stand out for a Family Services Caseworker role.
The line about facilitating family team meetings is a good model: it puts you in the room doing the work, without a generic claim. Your current role and Ohio LMSW are also easy to find.
